title: The Oath of Caerlum
author: A. M. Iversen
blurb: Petra Hartwell, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
